name: AI Walking Effect: Your Photo Walks Toward the Camera Like a Model
blurb: The AI walking effect turns one photo into a short video of you walking toward the camera like a model.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 7 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a sunny city street of pale stone buildings with iron balconies, wide sidewalks and a zebra crossing, the same 8 shots, camera angles, cuts, timing and moves. A full-body shot of the person from [Image 1] walking down a European city street, exactly replicating the motion from [Video 1]. The ONLY change: the woman in the navy jumpsuit is now the person in [Image 1].

The walker = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The walker wears the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest as a stylish street-style outfit that matches it. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also in the wide shots and when the face turns to the side. Never morph, never drift back to the original woman's face. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the walker is that animal walking on all four legs along the same path, with its own face, fur and markings and the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything. NO sunglasses unless [Image 1] shows sunglasses. No navy jumpsuit unless [Image 1] shows it. The brown bag in the hand stays.

The shots, matching [Video 1]:
Shot 1 [0-0.7s]: medium shot, the walker strides toward the camera on the street, bag in one hand.
Shot 2 [0.7-1.6s]: hard cut, full body from the side of the sidewalk, the walker walks past a stone wall.
Shot 3 [1.6-2.5s]: hard cut, close shot of the outfit from the neck down, the walker stands by the stone wall, a hand at the hip.
Shot 4 [2.5-3.4s]: hard cut, medium shot, the walker walks toward the camera and fixes a sleeve.
Shot 5 [3.4-4.5s]: hard cut, full body on the sidewalk by the crossing, a hand goes up to the hair.
Shot 6 [4.5-5.5s]: hard cut, full body, the walker crosses the zebra crossing straight toward the camera.
Shot 7 [5.5-6.3s]: hard cut, high angle from above on the white stripes, the walker's body from the shoulders down, mid-step.
Shot 8 [6.3-7s]: hard cut, side profile, the walker looks away down the street.
A relaxed, confident model walk. Keep the light, the street and the camera exactly as in [Video 1].

High fashion street style, realistic motion, cinematic quality. Real live-action footage, clear facial features, no distortion. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the walker's shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands, bags or clothes. Two arms, two hands, five fingers on each hand, two legs, natural steps. Exactly one walker; people far in the background stay small and unchanged. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no readable signs or license plates.
